<div class="card-body">
'''The First Transport Is Away!''' is a [[Light]] [[Effect]] ([[Utinni Effect]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">最初の輸送艇が突破しました！</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">任意の星系上（ホス以外）に配備する。ホスの位置にいる任意の中型輸送艇を目標とする。目標がウーティーニ・エフェクトに到達したら、Xフォースを再使用する。X＝乗客の人数の2倍である。ウーティーニ・エフェクトをホス星系に移動する。ホスの位置カードでの戦闘時に自分の合計戦闘力に＋2される。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-The-First-Transport-Is-Away-PSA-148375110.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「エネルギー・シールドを抜けたら、真っ直ぐランデブー・ポイントに向かいなさい。いいわね？ 幸運を祈ってるわ」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' The First Transport Is Away!.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy on any system except Hoth. Target any Medium Transport at a Hoth location. When the target reaches this Utinni Effect, retrieve X Force. X is twice the number of passengers. Relocate the Utinni Effect to the Hoth system. Your total power is +2 in battles at Hoth location cards.

'''Lore:'''
Once you have passed through the energy shield, proceed straight to the rendezvous point. All right? I'm wishing you luck.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The power bonus is at ホスの位置カード, not “Hoth sites.” Lore uses いいわね？ instead of “Understood?”
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[The First Transport Is Away!]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
